# CANDIDATE: MORNING_VOLUME_FILTER

**Filed:** 2026-08-20
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** filter_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The loser days (5/05, 5/06, 5/07) exhibit unusually low morning volume compared to winner days. By filtering out trades when the first 30 minutes volume is below 50% of the 20-day average, we avoid losses on loser days while preserving all winner days.

## Mechanism

At 10:00 ET each trading day, compute the volume of the first 30 minutes (09:30-10:00 ET). If this volume is less than 50% of the 20-day average volume for the same time window, skip all trades for the day. Otherwise, proceed with normal entry logic.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (same as base engine, as filter only skips trades)
2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 backtest used 16 months of data (n=342 days). Only 3 loser days in sample; high overfit risk if filter is tuned to these specific days.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window not yet performed)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top 3 J days not yet validated with realistic OPRA fills)
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: false skip on a winner day (e.g., 4/29 with low volume) -> lose $342
   - Max drawdown: if filter fails during a streak of unfiltered loser days, drawdown could exceed -$1,000
   - Blow-up scenario: failure to skip 5/04 (-$730) due to volume miscalculation
6. **Concentration:** Top-5 days (all winners) = 100% of P&L (342+470+730=1542); base engine concentration was ~60% ( winners / (winners + losers) = 1542/(1542-970) = 1542/572 ≈ 270% of net P&L. After filter, net P&L = 1542, so winners are 100% of P&L.
